selected_evidence.requirement: Daily rotation with seven compressed rotations
selected_evidence.summary: The installed policy specifies daily, rotate 7, and compress; forced rotation created app.log.1.gz; the global logrotate configuration recognizes the policy and the daily timer is scheduled.

selected_evidence.requirement: Application can continue writing after rotation
selected_evidence.summary: A writer opened the log before rotation and retained its descriptor. Its pre-rotation marker appeared in the compressed archive, while its post-rotation marker appeared in the active log.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID e65e6bcf-e09d-42b7-8317-cb6310086cb7, received safe reboot acknowledgement, observed changed boot ID fc8361f8-d3c5-4831-b634-288a8e19f16e, and verified the system was running with the timer active, policy intact, active log preserved, and compressed archive healthy.
